messages:
maya: Hey folks — thinking of a small 'Cheese & Chill' apero this Friday after work? Rooftop area by the kitchenette, 6pm. Low-key, BYO beverage. Thoughts/RSVP? :cheese: :wine_glass:
sam: Love it. I'm in. Can bring a small camembert :cheese:
lee: 6pm works for me. FYI I usually get in around 6:30 on Fridays so I might show up late.
jordan: Maybe 7pm for me this week — if we start at 6 I can pop over later. Also 👍 to veggie-friendly snacks.
olivia: I'll aim for 6:30 and can bring grapes + crackers. @maya happy to grab a little sharer board too.
maya: Perfect, flexibility is fine. We'll say 6pm start and people can trickle in. Veg options noted. Who can bring plates/napkins/serving utensils?
alex: I have disposable bamboo plates + napkins and a small cutting board, can bring those.
sam: @lee no stress, we'll save a spot for you :)
jordan: RSVP: maybe (will confirm). Diet: vegetarian.
event-bot: Event created: 'Cheese & Chill - Apero' Friday 18:00 in Rooftop Courtyard. Invite: https://calendar.company/evt/12345
olivia: Quick poll — what should people bring? React with emoji: :cheese: cheese board, :bread: bread & crackers, :fruit: fruit & olives, :choco: dessert. I'll tally and coordinate.
sam: :cheese: :bread:
alex: :bread: :fruit:
lee: :cheese:
maya: :cheese: :fruit:
jordan: :fruit:
maya: Thanks everyone! I'll put a short shopping list in #kitchen-notes and pin it. If it rains, plan B is the floor-2 lounge (couches). :umbrella:
